rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for belief in your own abilities, especially when discussing someone’s level of self-confidence.

example.english: Her self-confidence is strong, and she is not nervous speaking on stage at all.
example.traditional: 佢嘅自信心好強，喺台上講嘢一啲都唔怯。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ge3 zi6 seon3 sam1 hou3 koeng4 hai2 toi1 soeng5 gong2 je5 jat1 di1 dou1 m4 hip3

rows.note: Use this shorter everyday noun when referring to developing, gaining, or showing belief in your own abilities.

example.english: After doing it a few more times, I slowly built up my self-confidence.
example.traditional: 做多幾次之後，我慢慢建立返自信。
example.jyutping: zou6 do1 gei2 ci3 zi1 hau6 ngo5 maan6 maan6 gin3 laap6 faan2 zi6 seon3

rows.note: Use this when the context makes clear that the confidence is specifically in oneself rather than in a plan, person, or outcome.

example.english: Although it was my first competition, I still had plenty of self-confidence.
example.traditional: 雖然係第一次參加比賽，我對自己都有信心。
example.jyutping: seoi1 jin4 hai6 dai6 jat1 ci3 caam1 gaa1 bei2 coi3 ngo5 deoi3 zi6 gei2 dou1 jau5 seon3 sam1
